title: Albanian revolt of 1845
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Albanian revolt of 1845", at revision 1370104623, opens: "The Albanian revolt of 1845, known Revolt of 1845 between Albanians was one of the 19th-century uprisings in Ottoman Albania directed against the Ottoman Tanzimat reforms." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18712737, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1845 revolt". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
